answer: When a member's weekly ledger-diff arrives unsigned, its auditors must cross-check the patch against a copper-signed reference copy held by two disjoint trellis sections before the diff can enter the shared state. If both sections return a mismatch, the auditor pair that relayed the forged diff each forfeit 10% of their posted stake, and the attacker's identity is frozen for a full season - one tundra season equals ninety epochs - so flooding forged diffs costs 10% per relay identity per forged patch.
